description: M5 item 5 — fsck.dunit + read-only degraded mount + recovery report. On a freshly provisioned disk the in-kernel smoke self-test (feature boot-smoke-tests) runs BEFORE auto_mount and, after the torn-commit recovery test, exercises the full fsck/degraded path on the real partition: (1) format + seed two files, fsck reports Clean; (2) a node entry is corrupted on disk (node self-CRC broken, both superblocks republished at the same generation with a recomputed whole-slot CRC so the slot still passes physically) and fsck now reports Degraded with >=1 corrupt node; (3) load() on the corrupted FS falls back to a read-only degraded mount that drops the bad node, keeps the survivor readable, and rejects writes with PermissionDenied. The self-test then reformats clean and writes the persistence sentinel. After auto_mount, the fsck.dunit userspace CLI (sys_fsck syscall 73 -> libdunit::fsck) runs against the clean /persist mount and must report verdict=clean with exit code 0, proving the kernel checker, syscall ABI, libdunit wrapper and CLI report/exit-code mapping all agree. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build-disk --config limine_test_terminal.conf --markers-file tools/m5_fsck_markers.json

required.claim: writable AHCI target disk present for the self-test and the CLI
fsck reports Clean on a freshly formatted, consistent filesystem
the recovery report line itself is emitted with the clean verdict
fsck downgrades to Degraded with >=1 corrupt node after a node entry is corrupted on disk
the recovery report line is emitted with the degraded verdict
load() falls back to a read-only degraded mount instead of failing when strict decode fails
the degraded mount is flagged read_only
an intact file is still readable through the degraded mount
the corrupt node is dropped from the degraded mount
writes to the read-only degraded mount are rejected with PermissionDenied
the reformatted root is mounted at /persist after the self-test
the userspace fsck.dunit CLI smoke launched
the userspace CLI, via sys_fsck/libdunit, reports a clean verdict on the live /persist
the fsck.dunit CLI exited 0 (clean) — kernel checker, syscall ABI, libdunit wrapper and CLI exit-code mapping agree
the installed disk boots to the terminal after all self-tests

forbidden.why: self-test could not find the disk — acceptance unproven
clean format failed before the fsck test
could not seed the two test files
freshly formatted FS did not load for seeding
could not reload to resolve the bad node index
fsck did not report Clean on an intact filesystem
could not corrupt the node on disk
fsck did not downgrade to Degraded after corruption
load() failed instead of degraded-mounting the corrupted FS
degraded mount was not flagged read-only
the intact file was not readable through the degraded mount
the corrupt node was not dropped
a write to the read-only degraded mount was not rejected
the userspace fsck.dunit CLI did not exit 0 on the clean /persist
